triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear report of a systemic bug where delegating tasks to the generalist subagent causes gemini-cli to hang indefinitely. It includes client environment details (v0.32.1 on Linux) and notes a working workaround (instructing the model not to defer to subagents).
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Resolving hangs during asynchronous subagent execution requires investigating Promise chains, event loop propagation across derived MessageBus instances, and confirmation timeouts within the Scheduler.

summary.problem: Delegating tasks to the generalist subagent causes gemini-cli to hang indefinitely when executing tools that trigger confirmation requests or await subagent responses.
summary.root_cause: Tool execution within a subagent uses an isolated Scheduler and derived MessageBus. When a tool requires confirmation (ASK_USER), the confirmation request can stall or remain unhandled across the subagent-parent message bus boundary, leading to an unhandled pending Promise.
summary.context: Subagent tool execution is governed by LocalAgentExecutor and scheduleAgentTools. Disabling subagents allows the main agent to run tool calls directly without stalling.

steps: Inspect the tool confirmation flow in resolveConfirmation when invoked from a subagent context.
Ensure tool confirmation requests published on a derived subagent MessageBus properly bubble up to parent listeners or resolve gracefully.
Add safeguards and timeouts in waitForConfirmation to prevent promises from hanging indefinitely when no confirmation listener responds.
Verify that subagent cancellation signals properly cancel pending confirmation waits and clean up message bus listeners.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: Generalist subagent tool execution either completes upon confirmation or fails cleanly with a timeout/cancellation error without hanging the process.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in local-executor.test.ts simulating a subagent tool call requiring confirmation.
Verify that unhandled confirmation requests fail or time out gracefully rather than hanging indefinitely.
Verify that valid confirmation responses allow subagent tools to proceed and return results.
